verdict.rationale: Exa's API supports date filtering (startPublishedDate) and domain/path targeting, and its answer/citation feature returns sourced URLs, implying results carry URLs and dates, but no evidence pack item explicitly documents the search result schema (title, canonical url, publishedDate fields) or addresses duplicate/canonicalization handling for citation accuracy. Missing for 10: explicit schema documentation showing title/url/publishedDate fields returned per result, evidence of canonical URL deduplication, and independent confirmation that dates/titles are consistently accurate.
